Our Operational Process

Engineered for Precision & Speed

A transparent, rigorous 3-step methodology designed to eliminate unexpected failures.

01

Rapid Diagnosis & Inspection

We deploy advanced diagnostic tooling, performing mechanical teardowns, electrical insulation testing, and thermal imaging to isolate root causes.

  • ✓ On-site or workshop fault-finding
  • ✓ Insulation resistance & surge testing
  • ✓ Detailed engineering assessment report
02

Precision Overhaul & Repair

Equipment is routed to our workshop bays for complete copper rewinding, VPI treatment, or critical mechanical machining.

  • ✓ Specialized copper winding & balancing
  • ✓ Transformer oil processing & rewinding
  • ✓ Switchgear and substation retrofits
03

Rigorous Testing & Recommissioning

Units undergo extensive full-load and safety testing to ensure complete performance verification before recommissioning.

  • ✓ Dynamic load & performance testing
  • ✓ Quality assurance & safety sign-off
  • ✓ Rapid dispatch & installation support

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Common Technical & Operational Queries

Get clear answers regarding our workshop capabilities, on-site diagnostics, and emergency response pipelines.

What is your standard turnaround time for emergency motor rewinds?+

While repair times depend on motor frame size and extent of damage, our 24/7 workshop pipelines are optimized for rapid-turnaround emergency overhauls to keep downtime minimal.

Do you offer on-site fault-finding or must equipment be brought to Krugersdorp?+

We provide both. Field teams deploy nationwide for diagnostics and on-site testing, while major mechanical overhauls are routed directly to our Krugersdorp facility.

Do you handle high-voltage transformer maintenance and oil testing?+

Yes. We offer comprehensive transformer services including dissolved gas analysis (DGA), oil purification/filtration, bushing replacements, and full thermal imaging diagnostics.

Are your engineering repairs and testing protocols ISO 9001 aligned?+

Yes. All diagnostic reports, insulation testing, dynamic balancing, and mechanical overhauls strictly adhere to ISO 9001 quality standards and engineering specifications.

How quickly can emergency breakdown teams deploy to site?+

Our emergency response crews operate 24/7 and are primed for rapid dispatch across South Africa to minimize unexpected plant downtime during critical failures.

What condition monitoring services do you provide to prevent unexpected failures?+

We perform routine vibration analysis, thermographic inspection, insulation resistance (Megger) testing, and surge testing to detect early warning signs before total failure occurs.

Can your team overhaul industrial generators and HV switchgear?+

Absolutely. We specialize in complete maintenance, breaker testing, busbar refurbishments, and stator/rotor rewinding for industrial diesel generators and high-voltage switchgear.

What types of industries do you service for electrical overhauls?+

We service a wide spectrum of heavy industries, including mining and minerals processing, power generation, heavy manufacturing, municipal utilities, commercial complexes, and petrochemical plants.

Providing precision electro-mechanical engineering, 24/7 emergency breakdown support, and heavy industrial maintenance solutions to plants, mines, and utilities across South Africa.
